  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               An AC sinusoidal voltage of peak value 20V and frequency 50Hz is applied to half wave rectifier.       (4)  
  The cut-in voltage of the diode is 0.5V. If the load resistance is 700Ω and diode forward resistance  
  is 7Ω, Determine the following.  
  i) Average output voltage  
  ii) Rms output voltage  
  iii) Efficiency  
  iv) Ripple factor  
  Design a capacitor filter to reduce the ripple factor to half.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
1B)               A Germanium diode has a saturation current of 4pA at 270 C.                                            (3)  
  Determine:  
  (i) Diode bias voltage when diode current is 4mA .  
  (ii) Diode current when the temperature changes to 310 K, for the same bias voltage.  
  (iii) Also determine the dynamic resistance of the diode for both the cases (i) and (ii).  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"
